flattened_child_alternative.layer_contract: Existing M5 bank/SU leaves. Die owns M6/M7 and M8/M9 over them; M4/M5 remain leaf-owned. New regional glue defaults M5.
flattened_child_alternative.region_clock: Local roots per stage/lane region, each <=15000 sinks. Match routed child insertion; no M7 group clock spine.
flattened_child_alternative.rtl_requirement: Implement leaf-preserving decomposition of group FIFO/tags plus distributed parent rotations. Keep bank and SU leaf RTL/view bytes identical.
flattened_child_alternative.next: Spread lane-level exchange endpoints through actual free region area, assign corridors and <=500um relay sites, then compose every interface with existing demand.

bay_validation.note: Existing relay objects excluded because all affected relay chains must be regenerated.

exactness.covers: 64 bank rotations x16 element offsets, exact identity permutation; no RTL, SRAM, queue or cycle equivalence

throughput.required: One x beat per enabled engine edge; one row write/read and one SU operand request per hclk as existing contract.
throughput.latency: Additional pipeline edges must be carried by XVM, VL, rowvalid and hazard/land tracking; no measured new RTL latency.

adoption_gates: Allocate lane-level obstacle-avoiding corridors and registered seams <=500um, including bypass paths and all tags
Compose full existing die demand and every new interface at 260um fine windows; target <=0.60
Synthesize real regional logic; <=15000 sinks per new clock root and measured fit in bays/reserve
Bring VMT source to isolated candidate from pinned predecessor object; preserve live r6c and old views
Matched RV for all reads/writes; matched RO per return; preserve old-word 1R1W order and late-write hazards
Production NB3 exact RTL bench with x/SU/row simultaneous traffic and finite credits; all mutants fail
New group N-face view TT/FF/DRC/childlint/insertion, then real die netlist/cuts/STA/GRT/IR
